artworks.title: Military Commander on Foot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.1 × 8 cm (2 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in profile, facing left. The figure has one arm extended forward while the other hand rests on their hip. The person's face is in profile, with minimal detail on facial features. Their hair is styled up high, wearing a headpiece with a feather. The person is dressed in historical attire: a tunic with a fitted waist, puffy sleeves, and striped pants. They appear to be holding a long object in the extended hand. In the background, there are rows of soldiers holding spears or lances, along with figures on horseback. The background includes a low skyline, lines suggesting movement, and a pattern resembling clouds or smoke in the sky.

artworks.title: Military Commander on Horseback
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.6 × 8.2 cm (2 3/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a horizon in the background showing structures resembling a fortified city or settlement on a ridgeline or hill. The style features precise linework typical of etching or engraving, focusing on intricacy and detail. A figure on a rearing horse dominates the composition with elegant curves defining the horse's mane and tail. The rider, elaborately dressed, has an extended arm and a determined expression. Smaller figures suggest movement and action towards the city. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing contrast between ink lines and the paper for a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: Standard Bearer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with a figure holding a flag in the foreground. The figure is shown in a dynamic pose. In the background, there are smaller figures engaged in battle. The lines are precise and detailed, creating a sense of chaos and movement. The drawing captures the intensity of a historical battle with attention to detail in the garments and flag.

artworks.title: Skirmish in a Roman Circus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 8.1 cm (2 5/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large figure in a dramatic pose within an architectural setting with smaller figures engaging in conflict in the foreground. It features a central oversized figure with flowing garments and raised arms, amidst an ancient Roman amphitheater setting with pillars and arches. Surrounding the central figure are smaller figures in dynamic postures, some holding shields and weapons, implying chaos. The tall architectural structures add grandeur to the scene.

artworks.title: Piazza SS. Annunziata, Florence
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a bustling plaza or city square seen from an elevated viewpoint. A beggar on crutches is on the left, with his hand out. In the center, people are engaged in various activities, creating a lively scene. A statue on a pedestal is prominent in the center. In the background, there is a building with arches. The etching technique uses fine lines to create detailed textures. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and sepia.

artworks.title: Fireworks on the Arno, Florence
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.5 × 7.6 cm (2 3/16 × 3 in.)

artworks.title: Piazza della Signoria, Florence
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from an elevated position, showing a figure standing on steps overlooking a busy square. The background includes architectural structures and a gathering of people, horses, and carriages. A figure in ornate attire points toward the plaza, while the buildings and a tower in the distance frame the bustling activity within the square. The brushstrokes are detailed and linear, creating a complex scene with a color palette dominated by sepia tones.

artworks.title: Piazza del Duomo, Florence
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.7 × 8.3 cm (2 1/4 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a cityscape seen from an elevated point. In the foreground on the left, a large figure stands looking out over a square. Beyond him is a lively square with people, horses, and carriages. Rolling hills and distant buildings form the horizon, and the sky above is expansive. On the right, there is a tall tower with a flag and an intricate cathedral. The engraving uses fine line work to depict architectural details and the crowd. The color palette is limited to black and gray, typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Piazza Santa Maria Novella, Florence
artworks.description: The image displays an elevated view of a city square with numerous people and carriages. A solitary figure in a hat and cloak stands near the edge, overlooking the scene. Various buildings populate the horizon, with a significant structure on the right side. The sky is mostly empty with a few linear strokes indicating clouds. The style features detailed etchings with fine lines depicting architectural details and small figures, creating a dynamic scene. The color palette is monochrome with shades of beige, brown, and dark etchings on aged paper, giving a historic feel to the artwork.

artworks.title: Piazza Presso alla Porta al Prato
artworks.description: The image is a detailed line drawing with a busy scene depicted from a slightly elevated point of view. In the center, there is a large rectangular building with decorative elements. In the distance, other architectural structures can be seen, including what seems to be a dome or tower. Close to the viewer, there are many figures on horses, in carriages, and interacting with each other. The linework is intricate, capturing architectural details and figures with precision. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray against a pale background.

artworks.title: Piazza Santa Croce, Florence
artworks.description: The image shows a drummer overlooking a busy square. A large figure of a drummer is seen playing a drum with one hand and holding a drumstick in the other. In the background, there is a detailed open square or plaza surrounded by intricate architectural buildings. Within the square, many small figures are engaged in different activities. The scene includes horse-drawn carriages and various spectators, creating a dynamic and lively atmosphere. The lines in the drawing are finely drawn, indicating a detailed illustrative style.

artworks.title: The Catafalque of the Emperor Mathias
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.5 × 20.8 cm (7 5/16 × 8 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene from a 17th-century European setting. The image shows a grand hall with a high coffered ceiling and ornate architectural details, including Corinthian columns, archways, and intricate wall decorations. The hall is filled with groups of people engaged in a formal occasion. At the far end is a pyramid-like structure made up of various objects, possibly candles or ceremonial items, leading up to a central, elevated platform. Wall draperies add to the grandeur of the scene. The composition conveys a sense of solemnity and reverence, suggesting a significant event or ceremony.

artworks.title: The Catafalque of the Emperor Mathias
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.5 × 20.9 cm (11 1/4 × 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural interior with grand ceremonial elements. The image depicts an expansive room featuring large columns and a high, elaborately decorated ceiling. The walls are adorned with detailed moldings, reliefs, and draperies. At the far end of the room, there is a large candle-lit structure. People are gathered throughout the space, dressed in historical attire, some sitting in boxes elevated along the sides. The scene conveys the grandeur and splendor typical of important occasions held in such majestic venues.

artworks.title: The Cavalry Combat with Swords
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic battle scene featuring cavalry. The drawing depicts a dense and intense engagement between groups of mounted soldiers wielding swords and lances, with flags being prominently waved amidst the clamor. The horses are energetically sketched, capturing the movement and tension of the battle. The scene is rendered in intricate, fine lines that create a dynamic composition filled with urgency and movement. The smoky lines in the sky above suggest gunfire or cannon smoke, adding to the turbulent atmosphere of the conflict.

artworks.title: The Cavalry Combat with Pistols
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cavalry battle scene. It displays a chaotic skirmish among horsemen, with soldiers brandishing weapons as they engage in combat on horseback. The scene is filled with dynamic movement as horses rear up and soldiers appear to be in active confrontation. The drawing captures the intensity of the battle with swirling lines suggesting the dust and smoke of the conflict. One horse lies prone on the ground, adding to the sense of tumult and disorder. The background is filled with combative figures, illustrating the scale of the engagement, and the etching employs fine lines and shading to convey texture and depth. The overall composition presents a vivid portrayal of martial action.

artworks.title: Two Society Women
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.3 × 7.8 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing in an outdoor setting. The woman on the left is facing forward, holding up a large garment in front of her. She has wavy hair with a ribbon, wearing a long dress with voluminous sleeves. The woman on the right faces away from the viewer, holding a fan to her side and wearing an elaborate updo with a feathered hat. She also wears a dress with puffed sleeves. In the background are buildings, trees, and two smaller figures walking.

artworks.title: Two Zanni
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fantastical creatures interacting with each other. The drawing features two large figures with exaggerated, grotesque features engaging in a lively scene. Their poses are dynamic, with one creature bending slightly forward while the other leans back slightly, both with raised hands. Around them, a scene unfolds with smaller figures, some dressed in elaborate attire, featuring hats and clothing reminiscent of a theatrical or courtly setting. The background includes trees and structures, suggesting an outdoor scene.

artworks.title: The Winder and the Spinner
artworks.description: The image features two women seated facing each other, engaging in a spinning activity. Both women are visible in full, with their bodies turned slightly inward towards the spinning apparatus. The woman on the left is seated on a low bench or stool, with her hair styled in a simple fashion, pulled back and covered. She wears a long-sleeved dress that reaches her ankles. A small, curled animal is positioned at her feet. Her hands are holding a thread connected to a yarn swift. The woman on the right is seated on a wooden chair, with a straight posture and dressed in a full-length gown. Her hair is covered, styled modestly. She holds a distaff filled with raw fiber. The background is bare, emphasizing the figures and their activity, with modest furnishings and floorboards visible. The artist's signature, "J. Callot in. f.", is inscribed at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Young Jesus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.8 × 6.1 cm (3 1/16 × 2 3/8 in.)

artworks.title: The Young Jesus
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual is facing forward, with one arm resting on a table. They are holding a long staff with a cross at the top in the other hand. The person has curly hair and is wearing a long, flowing garment that extends to the feet. Next to them is a table covered with a cloth, on top of which is a decorative vase with foliage and a stack of books. Below their feet is a draped fabric or vegetation. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Title Page for "The Fantasies"
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate decorative title page. The image features an ornate border around a central text panel, flanked by two figures on each side. On the left, there is a figure holding a basket. On the right side, another figure is depicted wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a cloak. Above the central text is an intricate crest or coat-of-arms, draped with fabric, supported by two cherubs holding decorative swags. The text inside the central panel appears to be an inscription or dedication, dated 1635, and includes ornate script. The entire composition reflects a historical and decorative style characteristic of title pages from early modern European prints.

artworks.title: Lady with Dress Gathered Up, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures dressed in historical attire. The drawing shows the backs of three individuals who are wearing cloaks and hats, each standing in a different pose. The textures of the clothing are detailed, with flowing lines that suggest movement. In the lower right part of the image, there is an inscription written in a decorative script. The scene is rendered in monochrome, with precise lines and sparse shading that give a sense of depth and form to the figures.

artworks.title: Lady with Plumed Hat, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.3 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in period clothing. The left figure wears a feathered hat and seems to walk forward. The center figure wears a long robe and plumed headdress, with arms extended. The figure on the right wears a coat and feathered hat, looking slightly turned. Delicate linework outlines the figures against a plain background. A Latin phrase "Cum Privilegio Reg. Israel excudit" is written below the figures.

artworks.title: Lady with String Instrument, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.3 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three elegantly dressed figures. The drawing features three figures, each adorned in elaborate attire with prominent plumed hats. The central figure holds a musical instrument. The figures are delicately rendered, emphasizing their attire and accessories, while the background remains minimalist. The phrase "Cum Privile Reg. Israel excudit" is inscribed below.
